independence_evidence: About page: 'Pulp Literature Press was the brainchild of Jen, Mel and Sue, a trio of writer-editors' who publish what they want to read (https://pulpliterature.com/about/); the site runs reader fundraising drives to cover printing ('Keep the Presses Rolling 2026').
qualifies_reason: Independent small-press quarterly with print issues through Summer 2026 (Issue 51).
what_it_is: A Canadian quarterly digest of genre fiction, poetry and comics, with a strong leaning towards science fiction, fantasy and mystery alongside literary work. Issues run serialised novellas, contest winners and feature authors, and are sold in print and ebook form. It is for readers who like story-driven fiction in a pocketable, inexpensive format.
